conditional_algorithm_diagnostic.interpretation: Unmodified algorithm replay under conditional record treatment and input-order perturbation; not corrected physical actions, actual leakage, source identity or a change to the counted cohort

contract.objective: Census distinct raw-product IDs with matching retained camera metadata and test their intersection with the existing counted cohort without certifying physical identity or changing a denominator
contract.scope: Frozen raw crew-camera metadata assembled by Stages 10A and 10E, queried flight days 1 through 10, snapshot 10 October 2026; not a current archive or pixel census
contract.key_rule: All named fields must be single nonblank strings; preserve lexical values and leading zeros. Missing/multiple/non-string values are unkeyable, not matching nulls. UTC-semantic comparison is a separate diagnostic requiring an explicit offset.
contract.native_id_rule: One distinct product ID and capture stem per raw record; multiple representations are not pooled into this census
contract.conditional_diagnostic: Wrap the existing unmodified six-pattern action finder: original input order, reversed input order, and hypothetical one-representative-per-exact-nine-field-group lists choosing minimum or maximum product ID. All other records, patterns, counter/settings/span rules and source order remain unchanged. This is identifier-selection and reconstruction sensitivity, not physical deduplication or a corrected census.
contract.follow_on_diagnostic: After the predeclared reversal exposes a count difference, profile only the existing sort key (serial plus parsed shutter_count, with its existing zero sentinel). These ties are ordering ambiguity, not aliases. Count nonblank tags in each diagnostic's admitted identifier set to separate selection from reconstruction; do not choose a correct target value.
contract.stop: Reject a source/hash, completeness, scope, duplicate-ID or baseline-replay mismatch. Do not retry denied archive reads or infer a valid physical merge from a candidate match. Preserve original science receipts.
